revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - All corrections look good. L. 22 new reading could use a reg (ἐγγράπτου). L. 31 interventions should technically be PN corrections.

Submit - Insertion of a BL correction in line 24, of a scribal correction in l. 31 (νωρ corrected into νωφ), a scribal error in the same line (Πανο<μ>γεως) and a couple of new corrections in lines 13 (παρ᾿), 22 (ἐνγράπτου), 33 (ἐνκαλοῦμεν, πρόκειται), and 32 (πρόκειται).
Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - The print versions of PSI 13 1324 and SB 6 9369 both have the reading Ἀρμηνιακοῦ. The reading on the image is indeed clearly Ἀρμενιακοῦ.

Submit - Z. 3: Ἀρμηνιακοῦ → Ἀρμενιακοῦ. Der Papyrus hat klar Ἀρμενιακοῦ, wie man an der Abbildung im Internet erkennen kann. Die Verbesserung mit „|. Ἀρμενιακοῦ“ findet sich nicht in der Edition, sondern nur in der DDbDP.
